verdict.rationale: Graphite ships a well-documented official CLI (npm/Homebrew install, gt commands, git-compatible) with an interactive config command, and independent runtime probing confirms it installs and runs (v1.8.6) with real npm download volume; HN community members independently confirm heavy day-to-day CLI usage. Missing for 10: no first-party evidence of AI-specific subcommands built into the CLI itself (AI features are documented mainly as web/IDE features) and no independent benchmark of CLI reliability at scale.
